name: Sonic Dart
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level bard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 move action
Components V

EFFECT

Range 50 ft.
Target one creature or object
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a tiny missile of sonic energy that flies forth at a target you designate. To hit the target, you must make a ranged touch attack. A success inflicts 1d4 points of sonic damage plus an additional 1d4 points of sonic damage per three caster levels (to a maximum of an additional 3d4).
